record.file: <agents folder>/<viewer id>.json, readable by its user only (0600, the folder 0700)
record.host: the computer's host name (Python socket.gethostname(), R Sys.info()[['nodename']]); a reader skips records of another host and never deletes them
record.endpoint: http on a loopback host (127.0.0.1, localhost, ::1) with a port; a record naming any other is not read
record.url: where the viewer is served (scheme, host, port; no page address, which carries the viewer token), or null for a notebook widget
record.types: schema int; viewer, runtime, host, started, endpoint, token non-empty text; pid int; url text or null; dataset {id, name} of non-empty text, or null

agentsDir.posix: the folder must be owned by this user and writable by no one else (no group or other write); otherwise refused with sentences.folderUnsafe

endpoint.sweep: consumers silent for consumerIdleSeconds are dropped on a clock: their calls are cancelled in the page and their queued events let go

sentences.noViewer: No Cellucid viewer is open on this computer. Ask the person to open their dataset in a viewer (cellucid mcp --open <file>, or cellucid serve <file>; cellucid.show_anndata(...) in Python; cellucid::cellucid_view(...) in R), then try again; cellucid_status says which viewers are found.
sentences.notFound: No Cellucid viewer on this computer is {choice}. cellucid_status lists the viewers found.
sentences.notOpen: No page shows the Cellucid viewer of PBMC (served at http://127.0.0.1:8765) now. Ask the person to open its page again (the viewer address its program printed, or reload the page), then try again.
sentences.notOpenWidget: No page shows the Cellucid viewer of PBMC now. Ask the person to show it again (run the notebook cell that shows it), then try again.
sentences.pageGone: The Cellucid viewer's page went (it was reloaded or closed) before this call ended, so whether it was done is not known. Read the history (history_get) before trying again.
sentences.notTaken: The Cellucid viewer page did not take the call: {reason} Ask the person to reload the viewer's page.
sentences.stopped: The Cellucid viewer stopped ({reason}); nothing more was done.
sentences.folderUnsafe: The agents folder {folder} is not this user's alone ({why}), so no viewer is published there or read from it. Make it yours and not writable by others (chmod 700), or set CELLUCID_AGENTS_DIR.
sentences.sdkMissing: cellucid mcp needs the MCP SDK, which this environment lacks. Install it with: pip install 'cellucid[mcp]'

optOut.effect: no viewer is published to agents on this computer

progress: a call's notifications/progress count 1, 2, … (they must grow)
elicitation: a form elicitation goes only to an app whose elicitation capability is empty or names form; a question the page answers first is withdrawn in the app with notifications/cancelled for the elicitation request
